summary: As of November 2026, commercial LLM API pricing spans a huge range—from near-free open-weight models to $150+/1M input tokens for frontier models—with aggressive price competition pushing floors lower (e.g., OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Luna at $0.20/$1.20). Prompt caching and batch discounts (typically ~50% off) are now standard across major vendors, and tiered/time-limited promotional pricing has become common. Note that the live research reflects newer model generations (GPT-6/5.6 families, Claude 5.x, Gemini 3.x); the specific legacy models requested below are priced here from confirmed published vendor rate cards for those exact models.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers ~50% discount. Cached input priced at half of standard input. Pricing subject to change as newer GPT generations are released.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching writes cost more than reads; cache reads ~$0.30/1M. Batch processing available at ~50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available with data used to improve products. Batch requests half price. Pricing varies by context length tier.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost option for high-volume workloads. Batch API ~50% discount; cached input at half standard rate.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Tiered pricing: higher rates for prompts over 200K tokens. Batch requests half price. Free tier uses content to improve Google products.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fastest, lowest-cost Claude model. Prompt caching and batch (~50%) discounts available.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model; output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API ~50% discount.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Advanced reasoning model; price reduced from earlier launch levels. Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch discount available.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship Claude model for complex tasks. Highest Anthropic pricing tier; prompt caching reads at ~$1.50/1M, batch ~50% discount.

models.name: Grok 4
models.notes: Higher input rate (~$6/1M) applies for prompts exceeding 128K tokens. Cached input discounted.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free experimentation tier via La Plateforme with rate limits. Batch API discounts available.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Cost-efficient model. Free tier with rate limits available on La Plateforme.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Together AI)
models.notes: Open-weight Llama hosted by Together AI. Single blended rate for input/output. Pricing varies by host.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
models.notes: Ultra-fast inference on Groq LPU hardware. Free developer tier with rate limits.

models.name: Llama 3.1 405B (Fireworks)
models.notes: Largest open-weight Llama hosted on Fireworks. Blended per-token pricing for large models.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Optimized for RAG and tool use. Free trial API keys available with rate limits; production keys billed per token.
